segment.source: Whoever said the pen is mightier than the sword obviously never encountered automatic weapons.<end>

segment.source: It is fatal to enter a war without the will to win it.<end>
segment.target: It is fatal to enter a war without the will to win it.<end>

segment.source: Rank does not confer privilege or give power. It imposes responsibility.<end>
segment.target: Rank does not confer privilege or give power. It imposes responsibility.<end>

segment.source: It doesn't take a hero to order men into battle. It takes a hero to be one of those men who goes into battle.<end>
segment.target: It doesn't take a hero to order men into battle. It takes a hero to be one of those men who goes into battle.<end>

segment.source: Only our individual faith in freedom can keep us free.<end>
segment.target: Only our individual faith in freedom can keep us free.<end>

segment.source: The truth of the matter is that you always know the right thing to do. The hard part is doing it.<end>
segment.target: The truth of the matter is that you always know the right thing to do. The hard part is doing it.<end>

segment.source: What counts is not necessarily the size of the dog in the fight - it's the size of the fight in the dog.<end>
segment.target: What counts is not necessarily the size of the dog in the fight - it's the size of the fight in the dog.<end>

segment.source: You must not fight too often with one enemy, or you will teach him all your art of war.<end>

segment.source: Accept the challenges so that you can feel the exhilaration of victory.<end>
